item.title: Isolating VMs in Proxmox using VLANs
item.description: Proxmox + Pfsense are fantastic FOSS tools to run your own server virtualisation and home router. This tutorial adds VLAN tagging to an already existing Pfsense setup in a Proxmox managed VM. VLAN presents a convenient way to isolate subnets for logical grouping and security. Some of the more common use cases for wanting to do this include: isolating home automation devices (smart lights, security cameras, etc.) from your personal devices, creating a separate network for Wi-Fi guests, or segmenting a network to host a web server.
